scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.db:update: dotnet ef database update --project backend/src/AmbientWeather.Infrastructure --startup-project backend/src/AmbientWeather.Api
scripts.db:migrate: dotnet ef migrations add --project backend/src/AmbientWeather.Infrastructure --startup-project backend/src/AmbientWeather.Api
scripts.kill: powershell -Command "$p = Get-Process dotnet,node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($p) { $p | ForEach-Object { Write-Output \"Killed $($_.Name) (PID $($_.Id))\" }; $p | Stop-Process -Force } else { Write-Output 'Nothing to kill' }"
